Child JSON:
- `balls`: colour counts, total 2–30; proportion of `of`.
- `values`: 2–30 numbers; mean. One form.
- `n`: 1–population size; 1–30 with replacement. Clamp/report.
- `replace`: false; `repeat`: 1–200 (40); `seed`: integer (1).
- `stat`: proportion/mean; `digits`: 0–10 (2).

<!-- llm: omit -->
Copies with replacement; gaps without. Restore after recording. Seeded simulation, no answer preview. Final marker: population value. Caption: n and repetitions. Image label includes mean of sample statistics; author's label retained.

1184×440px suggested. One sample row; large n needs width. Text ≥24px; line spacing ≥1.45em. Dots shrink to radius 5px, then report size. Integer ticks for small integer ranges, otherwise 1–2–5 steps; proportions use quarters. Composition: red 3, blue 2; omit for cards. Incompatible stat: report, use form default. Missing of: first colour; absent: report, zero. Invalid population: report, no draw. Fictional simulations.
